## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the use case who would benefit from this feature and how they would use it.

## Provider Impact

Does this feature relate to a specific provider? [e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, All]

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the [issues](https://github.com/owenservera/vivim-final/issues) to make sure this feature has not been requested
- [ ] I have checked the [documentation](docs/) to see if this feature already exists
